title: The Funeral Pyre
text: Mourners in grey are building a pyre for a warrior laid out in her armour, sword on her breast. They are weeping and they are frightened. They have not enough wood, and the dead here will not rest unburned. Her fingers have already begun to twitch.

options.label: Give them wood, and help build the pyre.

outcomes.text: A fine burning. The warrior's fingers stop twitching. She rests.
The barrow dead come to see the burning, and are turned back by your steel.

options.label: The shrewdest asks after the warrior's grave goods.

outcomes.text: They sell you a sword they should have burned with her, and she would like it back.
